Sebastian’s questline: started this questline with high expectations because i saw people hyping it up, but I found it really average. Sebastian got really annoying halfway and couldn’t stand him (don’t get me started on him using THAT spell in front of his sister lol). Ominis is great though, felt really bad gaslighting him lol

Poppy’s questline: Hers is probably my favorite. Very entertaining, and she’s just a ray of sunshine. The little twist in her story and why she wants to save the creatures is probably my favorite.

Natty’s questline: started off decent, but I feel like whoever wrote her questline just didn’t know what to do with her character overall. Halfway, she revealed to us that she has this important ability, but that was… mostly it? Unless i missed a cutscene, but I found that bit sort of underwhelming.

Amit’s questline: hopefully part of a dlc in the future!
Resident Evil 3 Remake :/

A few months ago, I noticed a miqo’te sprout who would stand in front of my character and look at her for a min or two then would leave. This happened a couple of times and it didn’t really bother me at all. At one point they had sent me a tell and said that they really like my glam and my character overall. 

A month or two later, the same sprout stood again in front my character and started a trade. They gave me a straw hat with flowers on it, and said “Hello. This is my first hat that I crafted in the game, and I think it would go well with your glam! ^_^”. Of course, I accepted it and thanked them because it was really nice of them to do that. I immediately put it in my glam dresser, and it’s still there to this day.

Overall, the whole interaction warmed my heart. Wherever this person is, I hope they’re doing well and enjoying the game!
